test_title: SSC Steno 2021 Official Paper (Held on: 11 Nov 2021 Shift 1
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

To cut corners

options.text: To cut the corners of a cloth for stitching
To reduce corners in a building to save space
To remove sharp edges in furniture

solution:
The correct answer is: **To save money and economise**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **'To cut corners'** is used for expressing do something perfunctorily so as to save time or money.

 
 
• **Example -** *There is always a temptation to cut corners__ when time is short.*
 
 
 
• So, it is clear that the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom **'To cut corners'** is **'To save money and economise.'**

Hence, the correct answer is **option 1**.
